resolutions.note: src/browser/eval_adapter.py's criterion5 check now scans every tracked-looking markdown file (RUN_ROOT.rglob('*.md'), dot-directories excluded — rglob does not follow the .venv symlink) instead of a 5-file allowlist, and whitespace-normalizes both the document text and the forbidden/required phrases before matching, so a phrase wrapped across a markdown line break is no longer invisible. required_in now reads the same normalized, struck-stripped text as forbidden, closing the second hole (a struck 'RED on the deployed build' could otherwise satisfy the requirement meant to force it live). prompts/ and tasks/ are excluded from the scan by design: prompts/ is append-only (prompts/README.md's new 'Append-only' section states this explicitly, closing R3 by declared scope rather than by omission) and tasks/TODO.md legitimately quotes the forbidden phrasing while describing the bug/acceptance-criteria (discovered live: widening the scan without this exclusion produced a false positive on tasks/TODO.md's own M29 spec block, 'A-freeze is achieved', which is text ABOUT the defect, not an assertion of it). The remaining ceiling is declared in the case's provenance rather than left implicit: this is still literal (normalized) substring matching, not semantic, so a paraphrase evades it, the same enumeration-over-natural-language ceiling D12/D19 already name for this repo's other literal-phrase guards.
resolutions.red_watched: Two isolated demonstrations against the pre-fix (5-file, raw-substring) logic, run directly against _run_doc_counts_case with the ORIGINAL 5-file docs list (not the tracked JSON, so the real case file was never left in a broken state): (1) allowlist blindness — a scratch file docs/_scratch_r2_check.md containing the forbidden phrase, not in the 5-file list -> passed: True, wrong: {'docs': []} (wrongly green). (2) wrap invisibility — same scratch file ADDED to the docs list (so it IS scanned) with the phrase deliberately wrapped across a line break -> still passed: True, wrong: {'docs': []} (wrongly green; the raw substring search does not see 'criterion 5 green offline' split across a newline). Then swapped in the real widened+normalized code and reran the actual case with the scratch file present -> passed: False, wrong: {'docs': [{'asserts_criterion5_green': 'criterion 5 green offline', 'doc': 'docs/_scratch_r2_check.md'}]}. Scratch file deleted afterward; case is green again on the real tree (also confirming prompts/014-a-freeze.md's own unstruck 'green offline' wording, and tasks/TODO.md's quoted 'A-freeze is achieved', are both correctly excluded and do not trip it).

resolutions.note: Also addressed the acceptance criterion's first option directly rather than only logging debt: prompts/README.md gained an 'Append-only' section stating the convention explicitly (a dated record is never rewritten; a correction gets a new numbered file or a cross-link from specs/decisions/, not an edit), which is also the justification the R2 fix uses to exclude prompts/ from the criterion5 scan. T-R33 (tasks/TODO.md Debt) still tracks the second option — a one-line cross-reference from prompts/014-a-freeze.md itself to ADR-015's M29 amendment — since the review routed this LOW to debt rather than repair.
